scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && echo 'Installing Python dependencies...' && (pip3 install -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || echo 'Python pip not available, trying apt...' && apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3-flask python3-sqlalchemy python3-psycopg2 python3-gunicorn || echo 'Failed to install Python dependencies')
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Postinstall: Attempting to install Python dependencies...' && (pip3 install -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install -r backend/requirements.txt || echo 'Python pip not available')
